an4.60:1.1: kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca :--
an4.60:2.1: Catuhi kho gahapati dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihī sāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasopaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ. Katamehi catuhi? Idha gahapati ariyasāvako bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paccupaṭṭhito hoti, cīvarena bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paccupaṭṭhito hoti, piṇḍapātena . . . pe . . . senāsena . . . pe . . . gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārena paccupaṭṭhito hoti. Imehi kho gahapati catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako gihī sāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hoti yasopaṭilābhiniṃ saggasaṃvattanikan ti.
an4.60:3.1: Gihī sāmīcipaṭipadaṃ paṭipajjanti paṇḍitā Sammaggate sīlavante cīvarena upaṭṭhitā
an4.60:4.1: Piṇḍapāta-sayanena gilānapaccayena ca Tesaṃ divā ca ratto ca sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati Saggañ ca kamati ṭhānaṃ kammaṃ katvāna bhaddakan ti. Puññābhisandanavaggo chaṭṭho.
an4.60:5.0: Tass' uddānaṃ:-- Dve puññābhisandā dve {saṃvāsā} dve va honti samajīvino Suppavāsā sudatto ca bhojanaṃ gihī sāmīcināti.
